fichas.title: Cemetery layout and graves
fichas.summary: Cemetery planning guidance covers facilities, groundwater and water supply, path and planting layouts, grave types, grave-marker proportions, grave depths, and indicative grave sizes and periods of use. Earth burials are placed along main paths, boundary walls, and path ends; urn burials are placed in planting belts, urn groves, and hedge fences.
uses: Organizing graves by type and size

fichas.title: Columbarium and crematorium chapel
fichas.summary: A columbarium stores urns not intended for burial, as either a room or a wall with niches. The crematorium chapel serves all denominations and is placed according to cemetery size and layout. Its form affects the funeral ceremony; the functional diagram shows the chapel alongside ancillary rooms.
uses: Storing urns not intended for burial
Holding funeral services for all denominations
Supporting funeral services with ancillary rooms
